_note: Computer trainers' teams (change B). Roles: k, q, r, n, bLight, bDark, p (all 8 pawns one species). Exempt from the My Team rules. Capture moves come from kanto.json (PokéAPI red-blue learnsets, scripts/build-kanto.mjs).

rocketgrunt.source: Bulbapedia, Team Rocket Grunt, Red/Blue parties (Mt. Moon, Rocket Game Corner hideout, Silph Co.): Rattata, Raticate, Zubat, Golbat, Ekans, Koffing, Sandshrew, Sandslash. Bulbapedia page "Team Rocket Grunt"

rocketgruntf.source: Red/Blue has no female Grunts; owner default (a second poison crew built on Grimer and Muk, the recurring Rocket poison Pokémon of the Gen 1 era anime), filled with other Kanto poison types. Bulbapedia page "Team Rocket Grunt (anime)"

jessiejames-gen1.source: Gen 1 era anime (Indigo League): Team Rocket's Meowth; Jessie's Ekans/Arbok and Lickitung; James's Koffing/Weezing and Victreebel. Bulbapedia page "Jessie's Pokémon" and Bulbapedia page "James's Pokémon"

giovanni-gen1.source: The v1 Rocket team. Red/Blue Viridian Gym party: Rhyhorn, Dugtrio, Nidoqueen, Nidoking, Rhydon. Bulbapedia page "Giovanni (game)"

youngster-gen1.source: Bulbapedia, Youngster, Red/Blue parties (Route 3, Route 24, Route 25, Mt. Moon): Rattata, Raticate, Ekans, Spearow, Sandshrew, Nidoran♂, Nidorino. Bulbapedia page "Youngster"

brock-gen1.source: Red/Blue Pewter Gym party: Geodude and Onix; the other roles are fitting Rock and Ground types (Graveler, Rhyhorn, Sandslash, the Mt. Moon fossils). Bulbapedia page "Brock (game)"

blue-gen1.source: Red/Blue Champion party: Pidgeot, Alakazam, Rhydon, the starter that beats yours, and two of Exeggutor, Gyarados and Arcanine to match it. Pidgey pawns (his first catch). Bulbapedia page "Blue (game)"

red-gen1.source: The v1 Red team (Red's Pikachu, the three Kanto starters' final forms, Snorlax, Rapidash, Eevee).
